verses.text_en: And he said unto me, In the beginning, when the earth was made, before the borders of the world stood, or ever the winds blew,
verses.text_hr: I rekao mi je, U početku, kad je zemlja stvorena, prije nego što su granice svijeta stajale, ili vjetrovi ikad puhali,

verses.text_en: Before it thundered and lightened, or ever the foundations of paradise were laid,
verses.text_hr: Prije nego što je zagrmjelo i sijevnulo, ili su ikad bili postavljeni temelji raja,

verses.text_en: Before the fair flowers were seen, or ever the moveable powers were established, before the innumerable multitude of angels were gathered together,
verses.text_hr: Prije nego što se lijepo cvijeće vidjelo, ili ikada pokretne moći uspostavljene, prije nego što je bezbrojno mnoštvo anđela okupljeno zajedno,

verses.text_en: Or ever the heights of the air were lifted up, before the measures of the firmament were named, or ever the chimneys in Sion were hot,
verses.text_hr: Ili su ikada visine zraka bile uzdignute, prije nego što su mjere nebeskog svoda bile imenovane, ili su ikada dimnjaci u Sionu bili vrući,

verses.text_en: And ere the present years were sought out, and or ever the inventions of them that now sin were turned, before they were sealed that have gathered faith for a treasure:
verses.text_hr: I prije nego što su sadašnje godine bile tražene, i ili su ikada izmišljotine onih koji sada griješe preokrenute, prije nego što su bili zapečaćeni koji su sakupili vjeru za blago:

verses.text_en: Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam promotrio sve to: sve je bilo stvoreno po meni i ni po komu drugom; po meni će biti i dovršeno, a ni po komu drugom.

verses.text_en: Then answered I and said, What shall be the parting asunder of the times? or when shall be the end of the first, and the beginning of it that followeth?
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio sam: Što će razdvojiti vremena? Kada će završiti prvo, a započeti ono koje slijedi?

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, From Abraham unto Isaac, when Jacob and Esau were born of him, Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau.
verses.text_hr: I rekao mi je, Od Abrahama do Izaka, kad su se od njega rodili Jakov i Ezav, Jakovljeva je ruka prvo držala Ezavovu petu.

verses.text_en: For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.
verses.text_hr: Jer Ezav je kraj svijeta, a Jakov je početak onoga što slijedi.

verses.text_en: The hand of man is betwixt the heel and the hand: other question, Esdras, ask thou not.
verses.text_hr: Čovjekova je ruka između pete i šake; ne postavljaj drugo pitanje, Ezra.

verses.text_en: I answered then and said, O Lord that bearest rule, if I have found favour in thy sight,
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio sam: O Gospodine, Vladaru, ako sam našao milost u tvojim očima,

verses.text_en: I beseech thee, shew thy servant the end of thy tokens, whereof thou shewedst me part the last night.
verses.text_hr: Preklinjem te, pokaži sluzi svome kraj svojih znakova, od kojih si mi dao dio prošle noći.

verses.text_en: So he answered and said unto me, Stand up upon thy feet, and hear a mighty sounding voice.
verses.text_hr: Zatim mi je odgovorio: Ustani na noge i čuj snažan glas.

verses.text_en: And it shall be as it were a great motion; but the place where thou standest shall not be moved.
verses.text_hr: I to će biti kao veliko kretanje; ali mjesto gdje stojiš neće se pomaknuti.

verses.text_en: And therefore when it speaketh be not afraid: for the word is of the end, and the foundation of the earth is understood.
verses.text_hr: I zato kad progovori ne boj se: jer riječ je svršetka, a temelj zemlje se razumije.

verses.text_en: And why? because the speech of these things trembleth and is moved: for it knoweth that the end of these things must be changed.
verses.text_hr: Zašto? Zato što glas tih stvari dršće i potresa se, jer zna da se njihov svršetak mora promijeniti.

verses.text_en: And it happened, that when I had heard it I stood up upon my feet, and hearkened, and, behold, there was a voice that spake, and the sound of it was like the sound of many waters.
verses.text_hr: I kad sam to čuo, ustao sam na noge i poslušao, i gle, glas je govorio, a šum je bio kao šum mnogih voda.

verses.text_en: And it said, Behold, the days come, that I will begin to draw nigh, and to visit them that dwell upon the earth,
verses.text_hr: I rekao je: Evo dolaze dani kad ću se početi približavati i pohoditi one koji žive na zemlji,

verses.text_en: And will begin to make inquisition of them, what they be that have hurt unjustly with their unrighteousness, and when the affliction of Sion shall be fulfilled;
verses.text_hr: I počet ću ispitivati one koji su nepravedno nanosili zlo; tada će se ispuniti nevolja Siona.

verses.text_en: And when the world, that shall begin to vanish away, shall be finished, then will I shew these tokens: the books shall be opened before the firmament, and they shall see all together:
verses.text_hr: Kad se dovrši svijet koji počinje nestajati, pokazat ću ove znakove: knjige će se otvoriti pred nebeskim svodom i svi će ih zajedno vidjeti.

verses.text_en: And the children of a year old shall speak with their voices, the women with child shall bring forth untimely children of three or four months old, and they shall live, and be raised up.
verses.text_hr: I djeca od godinu dana govorit će svojim glasom, trudne će žene rađati prijevremenu djecu od tri ili četiri mjeseca, i oni će živjeti i biti podignuti.

verses.text_en: And suddenly shall the sown places appear unsown, the full storehouses shall suddenly be found empty:
verses.text_hr: I iznenada će se zasijana mjesta pokazati nezasijana, puna skladišta iznenada će se naći prazna:

verses.text_en: And the trumpet shall give a sound, which when every man heareth, they shall be suddenly afraid.
verses.text_hr: Truba će zatrubiti, a kad je svi ljudi čuju, odjednom će se prestrašiti.

verses.text_en: At that time shall friends fight one against another like enemies, and the earth shall stand in fear with those that dwell therein, the springs of the fountains shall stand still, and in three hours they shall not run.
verses.text_hr: U to će se vrijeme prijatelji međusobno boriti kao neprijatelji. Zemlja će se prestraviti zajedno sa svojim stanovnicima; izvori će stati i tri sata neće teći.

verses.text_en: Whosoever remaineth from all these that I have told thee shall escape, and see my salvation, and the end of your world.
verses.text_hr: Tko god ostane od svega ovoga što sam ti rekao, pobjeći će i vidjeti moje spasenje i kraj vašeg svijeta.

verses.text_en: And the men that are received shall see it, who have not tasted death from their birth: and the heart of the inhabitants shall be changed, and turned into another meaning.
verses.text_hr: Vidjet će to i ljudi koji budu uzeti, koji od rođenja nisu okusili smrt. Srca stanovnika promijenit će se i zadobiti drukčiji razum.

verses.text_en: For evil shall be put out, and deceit shall be quenched.
verses.text_hr: Jer zlo će biti iskorijenjeno, a prijevara će se ugasiti.

verses.text_en: As for faith, it shall flourish, corruption shall be overcome, and the truth, which hath been so long without fruit, shall be declared.
verses.text_hr: Vjera će procvjetati, raspadljivost biti svladana, a istina koja je tako dugo bila neplodna bit će objavljena.

verses.text_en: And when he talked with me, behold, I looked by little and little upon him before whom I stood.
verses.text_hr: Dok je govorio sa mnom, malo-pomalo gledao sam onoga pred kim sam stajao.

verses.text_en: And these words said he unto me; I am come to shew thee the time of the night to come.
verses.text_hr: I rekao mi je ove riječi; Došao sam ti pokazati vrijeme noći koja dolazi.

verses.text_en: If thou wilt pray yet more, and fast seven days again, I shall tell thee greater things by day than I have heard.
verses.text_hr: Ako se još više budeš molio i ponovno postio sedam dana, danju ću ti kazati veće stvari nego što si ih čuo.

verses.text_en: For thy voice is heard before the most High: for the Mighty hath seen thy righteous dealing, he hath seen also thy chastity, which thou hast had ever since thy youth.
verses.text_hr: Jer tvoj se glas čuje pred Svevišnjim: jer Silni je vidio tvoju pravednost, vidio je i tvoju čednost, koju imaš od svoje mladosti.

verses.text_en: And therefore hath he sent me to shew thee all these things, and to say unto thee, Be of good comfort and fear not
verses.text_hr: I zato me poslao da ti pokažem sve te stvari i da ti kažem: Budi utješen i ne boj se

verses.text_en: And hasten not with the times that are past, to think vain things, that thou mayest not hasten from the latter times.
verses.text_hr: Ne žuri za vremenima koja su prošla i ne razmišljaj o ispraznim stvarima, da ne bi brzopleto pohrlio prema budućim vremenima.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass after this, that I wept again, and fasted seven days in like manner, that I might fulfil the three weeks which he told me.
verses.text_hr: I dogodi se nakon toga da sam opet plakao i postio sedam dana na isti način, da ispunim tri tjedna koja mi je rekao.

verses.text_en: And in the eighth night was my heart vexed within me again, and I began to speak before the most High.
verses.text_hr: I u osmoj noći moje srce opet se uznemiri u meni, i počeo sam govoriti pred Svevišnjim.

verses.text_en: For my spirit was greatly set on fire, and my soul was in distress.
verses.text_hr: Duh mi je silno gorio, a duša mi je bila u nevolji.

verses.text_en: And I said, O Lord, thou spakest from the beginning of the creation, even the first day, and saidst thus; Let heaven and earth be made; and thy word was a perfect work.
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam: O Gospodine, ti si govorio od početka stvaranja, već prvoga dana: Neka nastanu nebo i zemlja! I tvoja je riječ bila savršeno djelo.

verses.text_en: And then was the spirit, and darkness and silence were on every side; the sound of man’s voice was not yet formed.
verses.text_hr: A onda je bio duh, a tama i tišina bili su sa svih strana; zvuk čovječjeg glasa još nije bio formiran.

verses.text_en: Then commandedst thou a fair light to come forth of thy treasures, that thy work might appear.
verses.text_hr: Tada si zapovjedio lijepoj svjetlosti da izađe iz tvojih blaga, da se tvoje djelo može pojaviti.

verses.text_en: Upon the second day thou madest the spirit of the firmament, and commandedst it to part asunder, and to make a division betwixt the waters, that the one part might go up, and the other remain beneath.
verses.text_hr: Drugoga dana stvorio si duh nebeskog svoda i zapovjedio mu da se rastavi i da razdvoji vode, tako da jedan dio može ići gore, a drugi ostati ispod.

verses.text_en: Upon the third day thou didst command that the waters should be gathered in the seventh part of the earth: six parts hast thou dried up, and kept them, to the intent that of these some being planted of God and tilled might serve thee.
verses.text_hr: Trećega si dana zapovjedio da se vode skupe na sedminu zemlje. Šest si dijelova isušio i sačuvao kako bi ti neki od njih, zasađeni i obrađeni po Božjoj volji, služili.

verses.text_en: For as soon as thy word went forth the work was made.
verses.text_hr: Jer čim je tvoja riječ izašla, djelo je izvršeno.

verses.text_en: For immediately there was great and innumerable fruit, and many and divers pleasures for the taste, and flowers of unchangeable colour, and odours of wonderful smell: and this was done the third day.
verses.text_hr: Odmah su se pojavili veliki i bezbrojni plodovi, mnogi raznovrsni okusi, cvijeće nepromjenjive boje i mirisi čudesne ugode. To se dogodilo trećega dana.

verses.text_en: Upon the fourth day thou commandedst that the sun should shine, and the moon give her light, and the stars should be in order:
verses.text_hr: Četvrtog dana zapovjedio si da sunce sja, da mjesec svijetli i da zvijezde budu poredane.

verses.text_en: And gavest them a charge to do service unto man, that was to be made.
verses.text_hr: I dao im nalog da služe čovjeku, što je trebalo učiniti.

verses.text_en: Upon the fifth day thou saidst unto the seventh part, where the waters were gathered that it should bring forth living creatures, fowls and fishes: and so it came to pass.
verses.text_hr: U peti dan rekao si sedmom dijelu, gdje su se vode skupile, da će iznjedriti živa bića, ptice i ribe: i tako se dogodilo.

verses.text_en: For the dumb water and without life brought forth living things at the commandment of God, that all people might praise thy wondrous works.
verses.text_hr: Jer nijema voda i bez života stvorila je živa bića na zapovijed Božju, da svi ljudi mogu slaviti tvoja čudesna djela.

verses.text_en: Then didst thou ordain two living creatures, the one thou calledst Enoch, and the other Leviathan;
verses.text_hr: Tada si odredio dva živa stvorenja: jedno si nazvao Henok, a drugo Levijatan.

verses.text_en: And didst separate the one from the other: for the seventh part, namely, where the water was gathered together, might not hold them both.
verses.text_hr: Odvojio si ih jedno od drugoga jer ih sedmi dio, gdje su bile skupljene vode, nije mogao oba sadržavati.

verses.text_en: Unto Enoch thou gavest one part, which was dried up the third day, that he should dwell in the same part, wherein are a thousand hills:
verses.text_hr: Henoku si dao dio koji se osušio trećega dana da prebiva ondje gdje je tisuću brežuljaka.

verses.text_en: But unto Leviathan thou gavest the seventh part, namely, the moist; and hast kept him to be devoured of whom thou wilt, and when.
verses.text_hr: Levijatanu si dao sedmi dio, vodu, i sačuvao ga da ga proždere onaj koga ti odrediš i kada ti odrediš.

verses.text_en: Upon the sixth day thou gavest commandment unto the earth, that before thee it should bring forth beasts, cattle, and creeping things:
verses.text_hr: Šestog dana zapovjedio si zemlji da pred tobom pusti životinje, stoku i gmizavce.

verses.text_en: And after these, Adam also, whom thou madest lord of all thy creatures: of him come we all, and the people also whom thou hast chosen.
verses.text_hr: A nakon njih i Adam, kojega si učinio gospodarem svih svojih stvorenja: od njega potječemo svi mi, a također i ljudi koje si odabrao.

verses.text_en: All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes
verses.text_hr: Sve sam to rekao pred tobom, Gospodine, jer si radi nas stvorio svijet.

verses.text_en: As for the other people, which also come of Adam, thou hast said that they are nothing, but be like unto spittle: and hast likened the abundance of them unto a drop that falleth from a vessel.
verses.text_hr: Za druge narode, koji također potječu od Adama, rekao si da nisu ništa, da su poput sline; njihovo si mnoštvo usporedio s kapljicom koja pada iz posude.

verses.text_en: And now, O Lord, behold, these heathen, which have ever been reputed as nothing, have begun to be lords over us, and to devour us.
verses.text_hr: A sada, o Gospodine, gle, ovi pogani, koji su oduvijek slovili kao ništa, počeli su biti gospodari nad nama i proždirati nas.

verses.text_en: But we thy people, whom thou hast called thy firstborn, thy only begotten, and thy fervent lover, are given into their hands.
verses.text_hr: Ali mi, tvoj narod, koji si nazvao svojim prvorođencem, jedincem i žarko ljubljenim, predani smo u njihove ruke.

verses.text_en: If the world now be made for our sakes, why do we not possess an inheritance with the world? how long shall this endure?
verses.text_hr: Ako je sada svijet stvoren radi nas, zašto ne bismo posjedovali baštinu sa svijetom? Koliko će ovo izdržati?
